materialization.notes: Materialized 177 variables across two modes (dark, light) via the repo-owned plugin's upsert rail against the canonical Collider file. Count rose from 167 with 10 light-side core anchors. The collection's single 'Base' mode was renamed to 'dark' and a 'light' mode added; renaming preserves modeId (dark is still 2019:0), so all 844 pre-existing node bindings survived with unchanged per-variable counts. Per-mode values spot-checked: semantic/color/background/base #171717 dark / #ffffff light, text/primary inverted, text/info #51a2ff dark / #1447e6 light, core anchors identical across modes as expected. Seeded components follow the page mode — verified by switching the Primitives page to light, confirming Code Block (2199:32) rendered light, then clearing the explicit mode.
